summary: Retest of the 'Nouvelle vente' dialog reset fix on /sales (frontend only). The 'Annuler' button now calls handleSaleDialogChange(false). After adding PARACETAMOL 500MG and typing customer 'TEST_Client', clicking Annuler closes the dialog. Reopening shows cart=0, total '0 GNF', empty product search, empty customer, payment 'Espèces'. Quick regression checks: (1) 'Mettre en attente' creates pending sale ATT-CB2 and closes the dialog, and reopening shows it empty. (2) 'Reprendre' loads the cart (1 item, 2 000 GNF). (3) Closing that dialog with Annuler and reopening shows it empty. No final sale was validated.

issues: The Code Promo input shows 'PROMO2026' in dark text on an empty form, so it looks like a value that was filled in. If this is placeholder text, use a lighter placeholder color.

action_items: UX note on existing behavior, not a regression: handleResumePendingSale cancels the pending sale on the server as soon as 'Reprendre' is clicked. If the user then closes the dialog with Annuler, Échap or the X, the held sale is lost for good. Its stock is returned, but the cart cannot be recovered. Consider cancelling the pending sale only when the sale is validated or put on hold again.
critical_code_review_comments: Sales.js is over 3600 lines. Split the dialogs (new sale, pending sales, returns) into separate components.
handlePutOnHold calls setCart/setSelectedCustomer etc. and then handleSaleDialogChange(false), which resets them again. The extra setters are redundant.
seed_data_creation: One pending sale (ATT-CB2, PARACETAMOL x1) was created during the test. The app removed it automatically when 'Reprendre' was clicked, and the pending list is now empty. So the confirm-dialog cancel step was not needed and was not run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login admin@pharmaflow.com/admin123, press Escape to dismiss the cash-register modal. Selectors: new-sale-button, product-search-input, add-to-cart-<id>, customer-search-input, payment-select, cart-items, cart-total, put-on-hold-button, pending-sales-button. Annuler: dialog button with name 'Annuler'. The reset fix is verified for Annuler, X, Échap, click outside, hold and resume.
